decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Live Binance has weakened since the 08:12 cycle: spot is 76803.44, below the UTC day open, with 12h/24h/48h changes of -0.26%, -0.62%, and -2.06%, while price is sitting much closer to the recent downside than to the upside targets Beecthor wants to fade. The bearish-bias correction is not active, and Polymarket has clearly repriced in the bearish direction: 76k DIP Yes is now 0.51 while 78k REACH Yes has fallen to 0.295. That makes 76k the nearest clean downside expression, within the preferred probability band, with strong expiry validity given 14 hours remain and the strike is only about 1.05% below spot. 75k DIP is still more stretched at 0.165, and 77k REACH is already above the hard cap.
